hindi: हे अग्नि, पहले तुम्हारे लिए सूर्या को वधू-यात्रा के साथ ले जाया गया था। वही तुम, हे अग्नि, हम पतियों को संतान के साथ पत्नी प्रदान करो।
english: To you, Agni, they first conveyed Sūryā along with the bridal procession. Do you, O Agni, give the wife to us, the husbands, together with offspring.
notes: naḥ patibhyaḥ: 'to us, the husbands' (naḥ may also be read as 'our husbands'). vahatu: 'bridal procession/conveyance'; the sense 'bridal gift' is also possible.
lines_deva: तुभ्य॒मग्रे॒ पर्य॑वहन्त्सू॒र्यां व॑ह॒तुना॑ स॒ह
स नः॒ पति॑भ्यो जा॒यां दा अग्ने॑ प्र॒जया॑ स॒ह
lines_iast: tubhya̱magre̱ parya̭vahantsū̱ryāṃ va̭ha̱tunā̭ sa̱ha
sa na̱ḥ pati̭bhyo jā̱yāṃ dā agnḙ pra̱jayā̭ sa̱ha

hindi: अग्नि ने आयु और तेज के साथ पत्नी को फिर लौटा दिया। इसका जो पति है वह दीर्घायु हो; वह सौ शरद् ऋतुओं तक जीवित रहे।
english: Agni gave the wife back again, together with life and splendour. Long-lived be her husband; he shall live a hundred autumns.
notes: dīrghāyuḥ ... jīvāti: no verb 'be' is expressed; read as a wish/statement ('long-lived is/be her husband who shall live a hundred autumns'). śarad 'autumn' is the usual word for 'year' in this phrase.
lines_deva: पुनः॒ पत्नी॑म॒ग्निर॑दा॒दायु॑षा स॒ह वर्च॑सा
दी॒र्घायु॑रस्या॒ यः पति॒र्जीवा॑ति श॒रदः॑ श॒तम्
lines_iast: puna̱ḥ patnī̭ma̱gnira̭dā̱dāyṷṣā sa̱ha varca̭sā
dī̱rghāyṷrasyā̱ yaḥ pati̱rjīvā̭ti śa̱rada̭ḥ śa̱tam

hindi: तुम पहले सोम की पत्नी थीं; तुम्हारा दूसरा पति गन्धर्व है; तीसरा पति अग्नि है; और चौथा मनुष्य से उत्पन्न होने वाला है।
english: You were first the wife of Soma; the Gandharva is your next husband; third, Agni is your husband; the fourth is the one born of men.
notes: The bride is addressed (te); 'you were' in line a is understood. 'manuṣyajāḥ' is taken as 'human-born (husband)'.
lines_deva: सोम॑स्य जा॒या प्र॑थ॒मं ग॑न्ध॒र्वस्तेऽप॑रः॒ पतिः॑
तृ॒तीयो॑ अ॒ग्निष्टे॒ पति॑स्तु॒रीय॑स्ते मनुष्य॒जाः
lines_iast: soma̭sya jā̱yā pra̭tha̱maṃ ga̭ndha̱rvaste'pa̭ra̱ḥ pati̭ḥ
tṛ̱tīyo̭ a̱gniṣṭe̱ pati̭stu̱rīya̭ste manuṣya̱jāḥ

hindi: सोम ने गन्धर्व को दिया, गन्धर्व ने अग्नि को दिया; अग्नि ने मुझे धन और पुत्र दिए, और साथ ही इस स्त्री को भी।
english: Soma gave her to the Gandharva, the Gandharva gave her to Agni; Agni gave me wealth and sons, and also this woman.

text_flags.why: possible: 'ṃsc' for the expected 'ṃś c' (putrān + ca gives putrāṃś ca); the Devanagari also has स्च

notes: 'her' is supplied in the first half (the object is not stated). dadat is read as an unaugmented past (3 sg.).
lines_deva: सोमो॑ ददद् गन्ध॒र्वाय॑ गन्ध॒र्वो द॑दद॒ग्नये॑
र॒यिं च पु॒त्रांस्चा॑दाद॒ग्निर्मह्य॒मथो॑ इ॒माम्

ra̱yiṃ ca pu̱trāṃscā̭dāda̱gnirmahya̱matho̭ i̱mām

words.gloss: O you two rich in prizes (epithet)

hindi: हे पुरस्कार-रूप धन वाले दोनों, तुम्हारी सुमति आ गई है; हे अश्विनो, हृदयों में कामनाएँ टिक गई हैं। तुम दोनों जोड़े के रूप में रक्षक हुए हो, हे शुभ के स्वामियो; प्रिय होकर हम अर्यमा के घरों को प्राप्त करें।
english: Your good will has come, O you two rich in prizes; O Aśvins, desires have come to rest in the hearts. You two have become guardians as a pair, O lords of splendour; dear, may we reach the houses of Aryaman.
notes: ā ... agan: ā is the preverb of agan (tmesis); 'vām' could also be read 'to you two'. 'ni ... araṃsata': ni-√ram 'come to rest, settle'. vājinīvasū: literal 'having the wealth of the prize/strength'; the rendering is approximate. priyāḥ is read as nominative plural agreeing with the 'we' of aśīmahi; duryān 'houses' (or household). 'hṛtsu' has no possessive; 'our' is not added.
lines_deva: आ वा॑मगन्त्सुम॒तिर्वा॑जिनीवसू॒ न्यश्विना हृ॒त्सु कामा॑ अरंसत
अभू॑तं गो॒पा मि॑थु॒ना शु॑भस्पती प्रि॒या अ॑र्य॒म्णो दुर्यां॑ अशीमहि
lines_iast: ā vā̭magantsuma̱tirvā̭jinīvasū̱ nyaśvinā hṛ̱tsu kāmā̭ araṃsata
abhṷ̄taṃ go̱pā mi̭thu̱nā śṷbhaspatī pri̱yā a̭rya̱mṇo duryā̭ṃ aśīmahi

words.gram: f. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √mand

hindi: वह तू प्रसन्न होती हुई शुभ मन से, सब वीरों से युक्त और प्रशंसनीय धन स्थापित कर। हे शुभ के स्वामियो, सुगम घाट, उत्तम जलस्थान; मार्ग में खड़े ठूँठ को तथा दुर्मति को दूर मार भगाओ।
english: Rejoicing, with a kindly mind, bestow wealth that is rich in heroes and worthy of praise. An easy ford with a good drinking-place; O lords of splendour, strike away the stump standing on the path, the ill will.

text_flags.why: stray avagraha inside the word (the Devanagari has ऽ); wealth (rayim, masc.) needs the accusative vacasyam

notes: 'sā' with a 2nd-person imperative: the referent (probably the bride) is not named. Line b has no verb for 'sugaṃ tīrthaṃ suprapāṇam': read as elliptical (understood 'give/make'); sthāṇum 'post, stump' is a path obstacle. durmati is taken as 'ill will, evil thought'.
lines_deva: सा म॑न्दसा॒ना मन॑सा शि॒वेन॑ र॒यिं धे॑हि॒ सर्व॑वीरं वच॒स्यऽम्
सु॒गं ती॒र्थं सु॑प्रपा॒णं शु॑भस्पती स्था॒णुं पथि॑ष्ठा॒मप॑ दुर्म॒तिं ह॑तम्
lines_iast: sā ma̭ndasā̱nā mana̭sā śi̱vena̭ ra̱yiṃ dhḙhi̱ sarva̭vīraṃ vaca̱sya'm
su̱gaṃ tī̱rthaṃ sṷprapā̱ṇaṃ śṷbhaspatī sthā̱ṇuṃ pathi̭ṣṭhā̱mapa̭ durma̱tiṃ ha̭tam

hindi: जो ओषधियाँ हैं, जो नदियाँ हैं, जो खेत हैं, जो वन हैं, हे वधू, वे तुझ संतानवती को पति के लिए रक्षस् से बचाएँ।
english: The plants, the rivers, the fields, the forests that there are: may they protect you, O bride, rich in offspring, for the husband, from the rakṣas.
notes: The relative clause of line a is picked up by 'tāḥ' in line b. rakṣasaḥ can be ablative singular ('from the harmful being') (rakṣas is a neuter s-stem; an accusative plural would be rakṣāṃsi, so the ablative/genitive singular is the only reading). 'na̱dyo̱3': the 3 marks a prolonged vowel in the printed text.
lines_deva: या ओष॑धयो॒ या न॒द्यो॒३ यानि॒ क्षेत्रा॑णि॒ या वना॑
तास्त्वा॑ वधु प्र॒जाव॑तीं॒ पत्ये॑ रक्षन्तु र॒क्षसः॑

hindi: हमने इस सुगम, कल्याण पहुँचाने वाले मार्ग पर चढ़ाई की है, जिस पर वीर कष्ट नहीं पाता और दूसरों का धन प्राप्त करता है।
english: We have mounted this easy path that carries one to well-being, on which the hero comes to no harm and obtains the goods of others.
notes: emaṃ = ā + imam; ā belongs with arukṣāma (ā-√ruh), shown separately here. vasu 'goods, wealth' (also 'good').
lines_deva: एमं पन्था॑मरुक्षाम सु॒गं स्व॑स्ति॒वाह॑नम्
यस्मि॑न् वी॒रो न रिष्य॑त्य॒न्येषां॑ वि॒न्दते॒ वसु॑
lines_iast: emaṃ panthā̭marukṣāma su̱gaṃ sva̭sti̱vāha̭nam
yasmi̭n vī̱ro na riṣya̭tya̱nyeṣā̭ṃ vi̱ndate̱ vasṷ

hindi: हे पुरुषो, मेरी यह बात भली-भाँति सुनो, जिस आशीर्वाद से यह दम्पती इष्ट वस्तु पाते हैं। जो गन्धर्व और दिव्य अप्सराएँ इन वनस्पति-वृक्षों पर स्थित हैं, वे इस वधू के लिए कल्याणकारी हों और ले जाई जा रही वधू-यात्रा को हानि न पहुँचाएँ।
english: Listen well to this of mine, O men — the blessing by which the couple attain what is desirable. The Gandharvas and the divine Apsarases who have taken their stand on these forest trees: let them be kind to this bride, and let them not harm the bridal procession as it is being conveyed.
notes: vānaspatya 'of the forest tree (vanaspati)'. devīḥ is taken in apposition to apsarasaḥ. vāmam: 'desirable thing' (also 'good fortune'). vahatu here 'bridal procession'.
lines_deva: इ॒दं सु मे॑ नरः शृणुत॒ यया॒शिषा॒ दंप॑ती वा॒मम॑श्नु॒तः
ये ग॑न्ध॒र्वा अ॑प्स॒रस॑श्च दे॒वीरे॒षु वा॑नस्प॒त्येषु॒ येऽधि॑ त॒स्थुः
स्यो॒नास्ते॑ अ॒स्यै व॒ध्वै भ॑वन्तु॒ मा हिं॑सिषुर्वह॒तुमु॒ह्यमा॑नम्
lines_iast: i̱daṃ su mḙ naraḥ śṛṇuta̱ yayā̱śiṣā̱ daṃpa̭tī vā̱mama̭śnu̱taḥ
ye ga̭ndha̱rvā a̭psa̱rasa̭śca de̱vīre̱ṣu vā̭naspa̱tyeṣu̱ ye'dhi̭ ta̱sthuḥ
syo̱nāstḙ a̱syai va̱dhvai bha̭vantu̱ mā hi̭ṃsiṣurvaha̱tumu̱hyamā̭nam

hindi: जो यक्ष्म वधू की चमकती वधू-यात्रा के पीछे लोगों के बीच चलते हैं, उन्हें यज्ञ के योग्य देव फिर वहीं ले जाएँ जहाँ से वे आए हैं।
english: The yakṣmas (wasting diseases) that go after the bride's bright bridal procession, among the people: may the gods worthy of sacrifice lead them back again to where they have come from.
notes: candram is read as 'bright' qualifying vahatum. yakṣma is rendered 'wasting disease' per the glossary; no modern disease is identified. 'janā̱~' is the printed form of janān before anu.
lines_deva: ये व॒ध्वश्च॒न्द्रं व॑ह॒तुं यक्ष्मा॒ यन्ति॒ जनाँ॒ अनु॑
पुन॒स्तान् य॒ज्ञिया॑ दे॒वा नय॑न्तु॒ यत॒ आग॑ताः

puna̱stān ya̱jñiyā̭ de̱vā naya̭ntu̱ yata̱ āga̭tāḥ

hindi: जो मार्ग में घात लगाने वाले इस दम्पती पर आक्रमण करते हैं, वे इन्हें न पाएँ। ये दोनों सुगम मार्ग से कठिन स्थान को पार करें; शत्रुतापूर्ण शक्तियाँ दूर भाग जाएँ।
english: Let not the waylayers who lie in wait for the couple find them. By the easy way let the two pass over the hard place; let the hostile powers run away.
notes: Object of 'vidan' (them) is understood. atītām is read as 3 du. imperative of ati-√i ('let the two cross over'); the subject is the couple. arāti: 'hostile/ungenerous power'.
lines_deva: मा वि॑दन् परिप॒न्थिनो॒ य आ॒सीद॑न्ति॒ दंपती
सु॒गेन॑ दु॒र्गमती॑ता॒मप॑ द्रा॒न्त्वरा॑तयः

su̱gena̭ du̱rgamatī̭tā̱mapa̭ drā̱ntvarā̭tayaḥ

words.gloss: I make appear, I make shine

words.gram: n. nom. sg. past part. pari-ā-√nah

hindi: मैं वधू-यात्रा को ब्रह्म से, घरों के साथ, अघोर और मैत्रीपूर्ण दृष्टि से एक साथ प्रकाशित करता हूँ। जो सब रूपों वाली वस्तु चारों ओर बँधी है, उसे सविता पतियों के लिए सुखकर करे।
english: I make the bridal procession appear (shine) together, with sacred utterance, with the houses, with a not-terrible, friendly eye. Whatever is bound around, of all forms: may Savitṛ make that pleasant for the husbands.
notes: saṃ kāśayāmi: the exact sense of the causative is uncertain ('make shine/appear together', or 'make look together'). brahmaṇā: 'sacred utterance' (alternatively 'by the priest/Brahmā'). The thing 'bound around, of all forms' is not named in the verse.
lines_deva: सं का॑शयामि वह॒तुं ब्रह्म॑णा गृ॒हैरघो॑रेण॒ चक्षु॑षा मि॒त्रिये॑ण
प॒र्याण॑द्धं वि॒श्वरू॑पं॒ यदस्ति॑ स्यो॒नं पति॑भ्यः सवि॒ता तत् कृ॑णोतु
lines_iast: saṃ kā̭śayāmi vaha̱tuṃ brahma̭ṇā gṛ̱hairagho̭reṇa̱ cakṣṷṣā mi̱triyḙṇa
pa̱ryāṇa̭ddhaṃ vi̱śvarṷ̄pa̱ṃ yadasti̭ syo̱naṃ pati̭bhyaḥ savi̱tā tat kṛ̭ṇotu

hindi: यह कल्याणी नारी घर आ गई है; धाता ने इसे यह लोक दिया है। उसे अर्यमा, भग, दोनों अश्विनौ और प्रजापति संतान से बढ़ाएँ।
english: This auspicious woman has come home; Dhātṛ has assigned this world to her. May Aryaman, Bhaga, both Aśvins and Prajāpati make her grow with offspring.
notes: astam āgan: 'has come home'. lokam: 'world/place' (the husband's home). Divine names are transliterated.
lines_deva: शि॒वा नारी॒यमस्त॒माग॑न्नि॒मं धा॒ता लो॒कम॒स्यै दि॑देश
ताम॑र्य॒मा भगो॑ अ॒श्विनो॒भा प्र॒जाप॑तिः प्र॒जया॑ वर्धयन्तु
lines_iast: śi̱vā nārī̱yamasta̱māga̭nni̱maṃ dhā̱tā lo̱kama̱syai di̭deśa
tāma̭rya̱mā bhago̭ a̱śvino̱bhā pra̱jāpa̭tiḥ pra̱jayā̭ vardhayantu

hindi: यह नारी जीवन से भरी उपजाऊ भूमि के रूप में आई है; हे पुरुषो, इसमें बीज बोओ। वह तुम्हारे लिए अपनी कुक्षियों से संतान उत्पन्न करे, साँड के दुहे हुए वीर्य को धारण करती हुई।
english: This woman has come, full of life, a fertile field; O men, sow seed in her. May she bring forth offspring for you from her flanks, bearing the milked-out seed of the bull.
notes: ātmanvatī: 'having a self/breath, full of life' (sense approximate). vakṣaṇā: 'flank, belly, cavity' (the plural 'cavities/streams' is also possible). 'Bull' is the literal word (ṛṣabha).
lines_deva: आ॒त्म॒न्वत्यु॒र्वरा॒ नारी॒यमाग॒न् तस्यां॑ नरो वपत॒ बीज॑मस्याम्
सा वः॑ प्र॒जां ज॑नयद् व॒क्षणा॑भ्यो॒ बिभ्र॑ती दु॒ग्धमृ॑ष॒भस्य॒ रेतः॑
lines_iast: ā̱tma̱nvatyu̱rvarā̱ nārī̱yamāga̱n tasyā̭ṃ naro vapata̱ bīja̭masyām
sā va̭ḥ pra̱jāṃ ja̭nayad va̱kṣaṇā̭bhyo̱ bibhra̭tī du̱gdhamṛ̭ṣa̱bhasya̱ reta̭ḥ

hindi: दृढ़ होकर खड़ी हो; तू दूर तक शासन करने वाली विराट् है, यहाँ विष्णु के समान, हे सरस्वती। हे सिनीवाली, वह सन्तान उत्पन्न करे; वह भग की कृपा में रहे।
english: Stand firm; you are a far-ruling sovereign, like Viṣṇu here, O Sarasvatī. O Sinīvālī, let her propagate (bring forth); may she be in the favour of Bhaga.
notes: virāj is rendered 'far-ruling, sovereign' (it is also a metre name). The subject of 'pra jāyatām ... asat' (she) is not named; it is taken to be the bride. Sarasvatī and Sinīvālī are names of goddesses addressed here.
lines_deva: प्रति॑ तिष्ठ वि॒राड॑सि॒ विष्णु॑रिवे॒ह स॑रस्वति
सिनी॑वालि॒ प्र जा॑यतां॒ भग॑स्य सुम॒ताव॑सत्
lines_iast: prati̭ tiṣṭha vi̱rāḍa̭si̱ viṣṇṷrive̱ha sa̭rasvati
sinī̭vāli̱ pra jā̭yatā̱ṃ bhaga̭sya suma̱tāva̭sat

hindi: तुम्हारी लहर जुए की कीलों को ऊपर की ओर मारे; हे जलो, रस्सियाँ खोल दो। वे दोनों दुष्कर्मी, दोषयुक्त और अवध्य अशुभ को प्राप्त न हों।
english: May the wave strike up the yoke-pins for you; O waters, loosen the traces. Let not the two evil-doers, the faulty, inviolable ones, come upon ill-fortune.
notes: Line b is uncertain. The text has mā with duṣkṛtau vyenasau aghnyau aśunam āratām; the referent of the dual is not stated, and 'evil-doers' sits oddly with a prohibition ('let them not reach ill-fortune'). aghnya = 'not to be killed, inviolable' (often of cows or cattle); aśuna is taken as 'ill-fortune' (uncertain). The yoke-pin line (a): ud ... hantu is read as 'strike up/out', but the sense of śamyā and the wave is also uncertain. A reviewer should check both lines.
lines_deva: उद् व॑ ऊ॒र्मिः शम्या॑ ह॒न्त्वापो॒ योक्त्रा॑णि मुञ्चत
मादु॑ष्कृतौ॒ व्येनसाव॒घ्न्यावशु॑न॒मार॑ताम्
lines_iast: ud va̭ ū̱rmiḥ śamyā̭ ha̱ntvāpo̱ yoktrā̭ṇi muñcata
mādṷṣkṛtau̱ vyenasāva̱ghnyāvaśṷna̱māra̭tām

words.gram: f. nom. sg. pres. part. mid.

hindi: अघोर दृष्टि वाली, पति का वध न करने वाली, सुखद, हितकारी, अत्यन्त कृपालु, घरों के लिए भली-भाँति संयमित, वीरों को जन्म देने वाली और देवों से प्रेम करने वाली तुम्हारे साथ हम प्रसन्न मन रखती हुई एक साथ समृद्ध हों।
english: With a not-terrible eye, no killer of her husband, kind, helpful, very gracious, well-restrained for the houses, bearing heroes, loving the gods: together with you may we prosper, being well-disposed.
notes: The adjectives in line a are feminine singular and describe the bride (addressed or described). sumanasyamānā is singular while edhiṣīmahi is 1st plural; a mismatch common in such texts.
lines_deva: अघो॑रचक्षु॒रप॑तिघ्नी स्यो॒ना श॒ग्मा सु॒शेवा॑ सु॒यमा॑ गृ॒हेभ्यः॑
वी॒रसूर्दे॒वका॑मा॒ सं त्वयै॑धिषीमहि सुमन॒स्यमा॑ना
lines_iast: agho̭racakṣu̱rapa̭tighnī syo̱nā śa̱gmā su̱śevā̭ su̱yamā̭ gṛ̱hebhya̭ḥ
vī̱rasūrde̱vakā̭mā̱ saṃ tvayai̭dhiṣīmahi sumana̱syamā̭nā

words.gloss: not a killer of the husband's brothers

hindi: यहाँ तू देवरों का वध न करने वाली, पति का वध न करने वाली हो; पशुओं के लिए कल्याणकारी, भली-भाँति संयमित और उत्तम तेज वाली हो। संतानवती, वीरों को जन्म देने वाली, देवों से प्रेम करने वाली और सुखद होकर इस गृहपति की अग्नि की सेवा कर।
english: Be here no killer of your husband's brothers, no killer of your husband, kind to the cattle, well-restrained, of good splendour. Rich in offspring, bearing heroes, loving the gods, kind, tend this household fire.
notes: devṛ = husband's brother. gārhapatya is the householder's fire (the household fire of the ritual); it is not further explained. edhi is imperative 2 sg. of √as.
lines_deva: अदे॑वृ॒घ्न्यप॑तिघ्नी॒हैधि॑ शि॒वा प॒शुभ्यः॑ सु॒यमा॑ सु॒वर्चाः॑
प्र॒जाव॑ती वीर॒सूर्दे॒वका॑मा स्यो॒नेमम॒ग्निं गार्ह॑पत्यं सपर्य
lines_iast: adḙvṛ̱ghnyapa̭tighnī̱haidhi̭ śi̱vā pa̱śubhya̭ḥ su̱yamā̭ su̱varcā̭ḥ
pra̱jāva̭tī vīra̱sūrde̱vakā̭mā syo̱nemama̱gniṃ gārha̭patyaṃ saparya

words.gloss: may you rest, may you delight

hindi: यहाँ से उठ जा! क्या चाहती हुई तू यहाँ आई है? मैं विजयी होकर तुझे अपने घर से निवेदन करता हूँ। हे निरृति, खाली स्थानों को ढूँढने वाली, जो तू आ गई है, उठ; हे अराति, उड़ जा, यहाँ मत रम।
english: Get up from here! What are you seeking that you have come here? I, overpowering, address you (from my own house). O Nirṛti, you who seek empty places, you who have come: get up; O Arāti, fly away; do not take your rest here.
notes: Addressed to Nirṛti / Arāti (personified misfortune and hostility). 'abhibhūḥ svād gṛhāt' is read as 'overpowering ... from my own house'; īḍe has the sense 'I address/entreat (to leave)'. śūnyaiṣī: 'seeking what is empty' (śūnya-eṣin), sense approximate.
lines_deva: उत् ति॑ष्ठे॒तः किमि॒च्छन्ती॒दमागा॑ अ॒हं त्वे॑डे अभि॒भूः स्वाद् गृ॒हात्
शू॒न्यै॒षी नि॑रृते॒ याज॒गन्थोत्ति॑ष्ठाराते॒ प्र प॑त॒ मेह रं॑स्थाः
lines_iast: ut ti̭ṣṭhe̱taḥ kimi̱cchantī̱damāgā̭ a̱haṃ tvḙḍe abhi̱bhūḥ svād gṛ̱hāt
śū̱nyai̱ṣī ni̭rṛte̱ yāja̱ganthotti̭ṣṭhārāte̱ pra pa̭ta̱ meha ra̭ṃsthāḥ

hindi: जब यह वधू पहले गृहपति की अग्नि की सेवा कर चुके, तब हे नारी, सरस्वती को और पितरों को नमस्कार कर।
english: When this bride has first served the household fire, then, O woman, make homage to Sarasvatī and to the fathers.
notes: asaparyait: the printed form is kept; it is read as a past 3 sg. of the denominative saparya ('serve'), and the ending -ait is irregular. 'pūrvam' can qualify the action ('first') or go with agnim ('the former fire').
lines_deva: य॒दा गार्ह॑पत्य॒मस॑पर्यै॒त् पूर्व॑म॒ग्निं व॒धूरि॒यम्
अधा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै नारि पि॒तृभ्य॑श्च॒ नम॑स्कुरु
lines_iast: ya̱dā gārha̭patya̱masa̭paryai̱t pūrva̭ma̱gniṃ va̱dhūri̱yam
adhā̱ sara̭svatyai nāri pi̱tṛbhya̭śca̱ nama̭skuru

words.gloss: let her be born forth, let her propagate

hindi: इस नारी के आवरण के लिए यह आश्रय और कवच ले आ। हे सिनीवाली, वह सन्तान उत्पन्न करे; वह भग की कृपा में रहे।
english: Bring this shelter, this armour, for this woman, for the woman's covering. O Sinīvālī, let her propagate (bring forth); may she be in the favour of Bhaga.
notes: Line b repeats verse 15b. upastire is taken as dative 'for the covering/spread'; asyai nāryāḥ together read 'for this one, for the woman's covering'.
lines_deva: शर्म॒ वर्मै॒तदा ह॑रा॒स्यै नार्या॑ उप॒स्तिरे॑
सिनी॑वालि॒ प्र जा॑यतां॒ भग॑स्य सुम॒ताव॑सत्
lines_iast: śarma̱ varmai̱tadā ha̭rā̱syai nāryā̭ upa̱stirḙ
sinī̭vāli̱ pra jā̭yatā̱ṃ bhaga̭sya suma̱tāva̭sat

hindi: जिस बल्बज को तुम बिछाते हो और चर्म ऊपर फैलाते हो, उस पर वह उत्तम संतान वाली चढ़े, जो कन्या पति को पाती है।
english: The balbaja that you lay down, and spread a hide over: let her mount that, rich in offspring, the maiden who finds a husband.
notes: balbaja is kept as a plant name (not identified). The yam / tat construction ties the two lines together.
lines_deva: यं बल्ब॑जं॒ न्यस्य॑थ॒ चर्म॑ चोपस्तृणी॒थन॑
तदा रो॑हतु सुप्र॒जा या क॒न्या वि॒न्दते॒ पति॑म्
lines_iast: yaṃ balba̭ja̱ṃ nyasya̭tha̱ carma̭ copastṛṇī̱thana̭
tadā ro̭hatu supra̱jā yā ka̱nyā vi̱ndate̱ pati̭m

hindi: बल्बज को लाल चर्म पर बिछा दे। वहाँ बैठकर उत्तम संतान वाली वह इस अग्नि की सेवा करे।
english: Spread the balbaja upon the red hide. Sitting down there, rich in offspring, let her tend this fire.
notes: rohita 'red' is taken as the colour of the hide. The subject of saparyatu (she) is the bride.
lines_deva: उप॑ स्तृणीहि॒ बल्ब॑ज॒मधि॒ चर्म॑णि॒ रोहि॑ते
तत्रो॑प॒विश्य॑ सुप्र॒जा इ॒मम॒ग्निं स॑पर्यतु
lines_iast: upa̭ stṛṇīhi̱ balba̭ja̱madhi̱ carma̭ṇi̱ rohi̭te
tatro̭pa̱viśya̭ supra̱jā i̱mama̱gniṃ sa̭paryatu

hindi: चर्म पर चढ़, अग्नि के पास बैठ; यह देव सब रक्षसों को मारता है। यहाँ इस पति के लिए सन्तान उत्पन्न कर; तेरा यह पुत्र श्रेष्ठ ज्येष्ठता वाला हो।
english: Mount the hide, sit near the fire; this god strikes all the rakṣases. Bring forth offspring here for this husband; may this son of yours be of excellent seniority.
notes: sujyaiṣṭhya: 'of good seniority' (excellent elder status); the sense 'eldest' is also possible. 'eṣa devaḥ' is the fire.
lines_deva: आ रो॑ह॒ चर्मोप॑ सीदा॒ग्निमे॒ष दे॒वो ह॑न्ति॒ रक्षां॑सि॒ सर्वा॑
इ॒ह प्र॒जां ज॑नय॒ पत्ये॑ अ॒स्मै सु॑ज्यै॒ष्ठ्यो भ॑वत् पु॒त्रस्त॑ ए॒षः
lines_iast: ā ro̭ha̱ carmopa̭ sīdā̱gnime̱ṣa de̱vo ha̭nti̱ rakṣā̭ṃsi̱ sarvā̭
i̱ha pra̱jāṃ ja̭naya̱ patyḙ a̱smai sṷjyai̱ṣṭhyo bha̭vat pu̱trasta̭ e̱ṣaḥ

words.gloss: joint wife, wife together with the husband

hindi: इस माता की गोद से नाना रूपों वाले पशु उत्पन्न होते हुए अलग-अलग निकल खड़े हों। हे मंगलमयी, इस अग्नि के पास बैठ; पति के साथ सहपत्नी होकर यहाँ देवों का सत्कार कर।
english: Let animals of various forms, being born, stand forth apart from the lap of this mother. O auspicious one, sit near this fire; as joint wife (with the husband), honour the gods here.
notes: saṃpatnī: 'joint wife' (shared with the husband in the rite); 'co-wife' is also a possible sense. prati bhūṣa: 'adorn/honour'. 'mātuḥ asyāḥ' may refer to the bride as mother or to the earth; the verse does not say.
lines_deva: वि ति॑ष्ठन्तां मा॒तुर॒स्या उ॒पस्था॒न्नाना॑रूपाः प॒शवो॒ जाय॑मानाः
सु॒म॒ङ्ग॒ल्युप॑ सीदे॒मम॒ग्निं संप॑त्नी॒ प्रति॑ भूषे॒ह दे॒वान्
lines_iast: vi ti̭ṣṭhantāṃ mā̱tura̱syā u̱pasthā̱nnānā̭rūpāḥ pa̱śavo̱ jāya̭mānāḥ
su̱ma̱ṅga̱lyupa̭ sīde̱mama̱gniṃ saṃpa̭tnī̱ prati̭ bhūṣe̱ha de̱vān

hindi: मंगलमयी, घरों को आगे बढ़ाने वाली, पति के लिए बहुत कृपालु, ससुर के लिए सुखदायिनी, सास के लिए सुखद होकर इन घरों में प्रवेश कर।
english: Auspicious, a promoter of the houses, very kind to the husband, a comfort to the father-in-law, kind to the mother-in-law: enter these houses.
notes: prataraṇī: read as 'one who carries forward/across' (prosperer of the houses); sense approximate. The second line has only five words; it is the verse as printed.
lines_deva: सु॒म॒ङ्ग॒ली प्र॒तर॑णी गृ॒हाणां॑ सु॒शेवा॒ पत्ये॒ श्वशु॑राय शं॒भूः
स्यो॒ना श्व॒श्र्वै प्र गृ॒हान् वि॑शे॒मान्
lines_iast: su̱ma̱ṅga̱lī pra̱tara̭ṇī gṛ̱hāṇā̭ṃ su̱śevā̱ patye̱ śvaśṷrāya śa̱ṃbhūḥ
syo̱nā śva̱śrvai pra gṛ̱hān vi̭śe̱mān

hindi: ससुरों के लिए सुखद हो, पति के लिए सुखद हो, घरों के लिए सुखद हो; इस सारे जन-समूह के लिए सुखद हो, इनकी पुष्टि के लिए सुखद हो।
english: Be kind to the fathers-in-law, kind to the husband, kind to the houses; kind to all this clan, and be kind for the nourishment of these.
notes: śvaśurebhyaḥ is plural: 'fathers-in-law' (the husband's father and his kin). viś: 'clan, people, settlement'.
lines_deva: स्यो॒ना भ॑व॒ श्वशु॑रेभ्यः स्यो॒ना पत्ये॑ गृ॒हेभ्यः॑
स्यो॒नास्यै सर्व॑स्यै वि॒शे स्यो॒ना पु॒ष्टायै॑षां भव
lines_iast: syo̱nā bha̭va̱ śvaśṷrebhyaḥ syo̱nā patyḙ gṛ̱hebhya̭ḥ
syo̱nāsyai sarva̭syai vi̱śe syo̱nā pu̱ṣṭāyai̭ṣāṃ bhava

hindi: यह वधू मंगलमयी है; इसके पास एक साथ आओ और इसे देखो। इसे सौभाग्य देकर दुर्भाग्यों के साथ दूर चले जाओ।
english: This bride is auspicious; come together and look at her. Having given her good fortune, go away with ill-fortunes.
notes: daurbhāgyaiḥ is instrumental plural: 'with (your) ill-fortunes'.
lines_deva: सु॒म॒ङ्ग॒लीरि॒यं व॒धूरि॒मां स॒मेत॒ पश्य॑त
सौभा॑ग्यम॒स्यै द॒त्त्वा दौर्भा॑ग्यैर्वि॒परे॑तन
lines_iast: su̱ma̱ṅga̱līri̱yaṃ va̱dhūri̱māṃ sa̱meta̱ paśya̭ta
saubhā̭gyama̱syai da̱ttvā daurbhā̭gyairvi̱parḙtana

hindi: जो दुष्ट हृदय वाली युवतियाँ हैं और जो यहाँ वृद्धाएँ भी हैं, तुम इसे अब तेज दो, फिर घर चली जाओ।
english: You young women who are ill-hearted, and you who are old women here as well: now give her splendour, and then go away home.
notes: The nominatives in line a are taken as addressed to those women. varcas 'splendour, vigour'. astam 'home' (as in verse 13).
lines_deva: या दु॒र्हार्दो॑ युव॒तयो॒ याश्चे॒ह ज॑रती॒रपि॑
वर्चो॒ न्व॑स्यै सं द॒त्ताथास्तं॑ वि॒परे॑तन
lines_iast: yā du̱rhārdo̭ yuva̱tayo̱ yāśce̱ha ja̭ratī̱rapi̭
varco̱ nva̭syai saṃ da̱ttāthāsta̭ṃ vi̱parḙtana

hindi: सोने के बिछौने वाले, सब रूपों को धारण करने वाले वाहन पर सविता की पुत्री सूर्या बड़े सौभाग्य के लिए चढ़ी।
english: Sūryā, Savitṛ's daughter, mounted the conveyance with a golden spread, bearing all forms, for great good fortune.
notes: vahya is taken as 'conveyance, vehicle'. kam 'for well-being' (particle). ārohat is read as past (augmented).
lines_deva: रु॒क्म॒प्रस्त॑रणं व॒ह्यं विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ बिभ्र॑तम्
आरो॑हत् सू॒र्या सा॑वि॒त्री बृ॑ह॒ते सौभ॑गाय॒ कम्
lines_iast: ru̱kma̱prasta̭raṇaṃ va̱hyaṃ viśvā̭ rū̱pāṇi̱ bibhra̭tam
āro̭hat sū̱ryā sā̭vi̱trī bṛ̭ha̱te saubha̭gāya̱ kam

words.gram: f. voc. sg. pres. part. mid.
f. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √budh

hindi: हे प्रसन्न मन वाली, पलंग पर चढ़ और यहाँ इस पति के लिए संतान उत्पन्न कर। इन्द्राणी की तरह भली-भाँति जागने वाली और जागती हुई, तू प्रकाश को आगे रखने वाली उषाओं के सामने जागती रह।
english: Mount the couch, O well-disposed one, and bring forth offspring here for this husband. Like Indrāṇī, well awake and waking, you shall keep awake toward the dawns that have light in front.
notes: jyotiragrāḥ (printed jyotiragrā) qualifies uṣasaḥ. jāgarāsi is read as present/subjunctive of √jāgṛ.
lines_deva: आ रो॑ह॒ तल्पं सुमन॒स्यमा॑ने॒ह प्र॒जां ज॑नय॒ पत्ये॑ अ॒स्मै
इ॒न्द्रा॒णीव॑ सु॒बुधा॒ बुध्य॑माना॒ ज्योति॑रग्रा उ॒षसः॒ प्रति॑ जागरासि
lines_iast: ā ro̭ha̱ talpaṃ sumana̱syamā̭ne̱ha pra̱jāṃ ja̭naya̱ patyḙ a̱smai
i̱ndrā̱ṇīva̭ su̱budhā̱ budhya̭mānā̱ jyoti̭ragrā u̱ṣasa̱ḥ prati̭ jāgarāsi

hindi: देवों ने पहले पत्नियों के पास जाकर शरीरों से शरीरों का स्पर्श किया। सूर्या के समान, हे नारी, अपनी महिमा से सब रूपों वाली और संतानवती होकर यहाँ पति के साथ मिल जा।
english: At first the gods approached the wives; they touched body to body. Like Sūryā, O woman, of all forms in your greatness, rich in offspring, be united here with your husband.

notes: ni-√pad is rendered 'approached, went to'; the exact nuance ('lay down with') is not certain. The read 'tanvaḥ tanūbhiḥ' (bodies with bodies) assumes the avagraha is a misprint.
lines_deva: दे॒वा अग्रे॒ न्यपद्यन्त॒ पत्नीः॒ सम॑स्पृशन्त त॒न्वऽस्त॒नूभिः॑
सू॒र्येव॑ नारि वि॒श्वरू॑पा महि॒त्वा प्र॒जाव॑ती॒ पत्या॒ सं भ॑वे॒ह
lines_iast: de̱vā agre̱ nyapadyanta̱ patnī̱ḥ sama̭spṛśanta ta̱nva'sta̱nūbhi̭ḥ

hindi: यहाँ से उठ, हे विश्वावसु; हम नमस्कार से तेरी स्तुति करते हैं। पितृगृह में बैठी, अलंकृत बहन को ढूँढ; वह जन्म से तेरा भाग है, उसे जान।
english: Get up from here, O Viśvāvasu; we entreat you with homage. Seek a kinswoman sitting in her father's house, anointed; that is your portion by birth — know it.
notes: nyaktām: 'anointed/adorned' (ni-√añj) is uncertain. jāmi can mean 'sister, kinswoman'. 'tasya viddhi' is read as 'take notice of it (that)'. Viśvāvasu is a name (its bearer's role is not stated in this verse).
lines_deva: उत् ति॑ष्ठे॒तो वि॑श्वावसो॒ नम॑सेडामहे त्वा
जा॒मिमि॑च्छ पितृ॒षदं॒ न्यक्तां॒ स ते॑ भा॒गो ज॒नुषा॒ तस्य॑ विद्धि
lines_iast: ut ti̭ṣṭhe̱to vi̭śvāvaso̱ nama̭seḍāmahe tvā
jā̱mimi̭ccha pitṛ̱ṣada̱ṃ nyaktā̱ṃ sa tḙ bhā̱go ja̱nuṣā̱ tasya̭ viddhi

hindi: अप्सराएँ हविर्धान और सूर्य के बीच साझे आनन्द में मग्न होती हैं। वे तेरी जन्मभूमि हैं; उन्हीं के पास चला जा। हे गन्धर्व, मैं तुझे उचित ऋतु में नमस्कार करता हूँ।
english: The Apsarases revel in joint revelry between the havirdhāna and the sun. They are your birthplace; go away to them. Homage to you, O Gandharva; I make it in due season.
notes: havirdhāna is a ritual term (the oblation-holder), kept untranslated. 'tāḥ te janitram abhi tāḥ parehi' is uncertain: 'they are your origin' or 'to your birthplace, to them go away'. ṛtunā 'in due season' (or 'by the order').
lines_deva: अ॒प्स॒रसः॑ सध॒मादं॑ मदन्ति हवि॒र्धान॑मन्त॒रा सूर्यं॑ च
तास्ते॑ ज॒नित्र॑म॒भि ताः परे॑हि॒ नम॑स्ते गन्धर्व॒र्तुना॑ कृणोमि
lines_iast: a̱psa̱rasa̭ḥ sadha̱māda̭ṃ madanti havi̱rdhāna̭manta̱rā sūrya̭ṃ ca
tāstḙ ja̱nitra̭ma̱bhi tāḥ parḙhi̱ nama̭ste gandharva̱rtunā̭ kṛṇomi

hindi: गन्धर्व के नमस्कार के लिए नमस्कार; तेज और आँख को हम नमस्कार करते हैं। हे विश्वावसु, ब्रह्म से तुझे नमस्कार है; पत्नियों, अप्सराओं के पास चला जा।
english: Homage to the Gandharva, to his homage; homage we make to radiance and to the eye. O Viśvāvasu, homage to you with sacred utterance; go away to the wives, the Apsarases.
notes: 'namo gandharvasya namase' is uncertain: namase may be read 'to the one deserving homage'. bhāma 'radiance' (it can also mean 'wrath'). brahmaṇā 'with sacred utterance' (alternatively 'with the priest').
lines_deva: नमो॑ गन्ध॒र्वस्य॒ नम॑से॒ नमो॒ भामा॑य॒ चक्षु॑षे च कृण्मः
विश्वा॑वसो॒ ब्रह्म॑णा ते॒ नमो॒ऽभि जा॒या अ॑प्स॒रसः॒ परे॑हि
lines_iast: namo̭ gandha̱rvasya̱ nama̭se̱ namo̱ bhāmā̭ya̱ cakṣṷṣe ca kṛṇmaḥ
viśvā̭vaso̱ brahma̭ṇā te̱ namo̱'bhi jā̱yā a̭psa̱rasa̱ḥ parḙhi

hindi: धन से हम प्रसन्न मन वाले हों; यहाँ से हमने गन्धर्व को ऊपर की ओर मोड़ दिया है। वह देव परम सहस्थान को चला गया है; हम वहाँ आ गए हैं जहाँ लोग आयु को बढ़ाते हैं।
english: May we be well-minded with wealth; from here we have turned the Gandharva up. That god has gone to the highest common abode; we have gone where they prolong life.
notes: 'ud ... āvīvṛtāma' is uncertain ('we have turned him up/away'). 'pra tiranta āyuḥ' is read as 'they prolong life' (pra-√tṝ); the subject (they) is not named. sadhastha 'common abode, station'.
lines_deva: रा॒या व॒यं सु॒मन॑सः स्या॒मोदि॒तो ग॑न्ध॒र्वमावी॑वृताम
अग॑न्त्स दे॒वः प॑र॒मं स॒धस्थ॒मग॑न्म॒ यत्र॑ प्रति॒रन्त॒ आयुः॑
lines_iast: rā̱yā va̱yaṃ su̱mana̭saḥ syā̱modi̱to ga̭ndha̱rvamāvī̭vṛtāma
aga̭ntsa de̱vaḥ pa̭ra̱maṃ sa̱dhastha̱maga̭nma̱ yatra̭ prati̱ranta̱ āyṷḥ

hindi: हे दोनों माता-पिता, उचित ऋतु में मिलो; तुम दोनों वीर्य द्वारा माता और पिता बनोगे। जैसे पुरुष युवती को, वैसे इसे ऊपर चढ़ा। तुम दोनों सन्तान उत्पन्न करो और यहाँ धन में समृद्ध होओ।
english: Unite in due season, you two parents; you two shall become mother and father by the seed. Like a young man a young woman, cause her to mount; make offspring, and here thrive in wealth.
notes: pitarau (dual) is read as the pair to become parents. 'retasaḥ' is read as 'of/by seed'. Line b is uncertain: 'maryaḥ iva yoṣām adhirohaya enām' is taken as 'like a young man (does) a young woman, cause her to mount'; the object of the causative and what she mounts are not stated.
lines_deva: सं पि॑तरा॒वृत्वि॑ये सृजेथां मा॒ता पि॒ता च॒ रेत॑सो भवाथः
मर्य॑ इव॒ योषा॒मधि॑रोहयैनां प्र॒जां कृ॑ण्वाथामि॒ह पु॑ष्यतं र॒यिम्
lines_iast: saṃ pi̭tarā̱vṛtvi̭ye sṛjethāṃ mā̱tā pi̱tā ca̱ reta̭so bhavāthaḥ
marya̭ iva̱ yoṣā̱madhi̭rohayaināṃ pra̱jāṃ kṛ̭ṇvāthāmi̱ha pṷṣyataṃ ra̱yim

hindi: हे पूषा, उस अतिशय कल्याणी स्त्री को प्रेरित करो, जिसमें मनुष्य बीज बोते हैं; जो कामना करती हुई हमारे लिए अपनी जंघाएँ फैलाए, जिसमें कामना करते हुए हम अपना शिश्न प्रविष्ट करें।
english: O Pūṣan, rouse that most kind woman, in whom men sow seed; she who, desiring, spreads her two thighs apart for us, in whom, desiring, we may thrust the male organ.
notes: The text is explicit; it is rendered literally. 'ā īrayasva' is read as 'rouse, set in motion toward (us)'. 'ūrū' is taken as dual 'two thighs'. 'praharema' (pra-√hṛ) 'thrust in'.
lines_deva: तां पूषं॑छि॒वत॑मा॒मेर॑यस्व॒ यस्यां॒ बीजं॑ मनु॒ष्या॒३वप॑न्ति
या न॑ ऊ॒रू उ॑श॒ती वि॒श्रया॑ति॒ यस्या॑मु॒शन्तः॑ प्र॒हरे॑म॒ शेपः॑
lines_iast: tāṃ pūṣa̭ṃchi̱vata̭mā̱mera̭yasva̱ yasyā̱ṃ bīja̭ṃ manu̱ṣyā̱3vapa̭nti
yā na̭ ū̱rū ṷśa̱tī vi̱śrayā̭ti̱ yasyā̭mu̱śanta̭ḥ pra̱harḙma̱ śepa̭ḥ

hindi: चढ़ो, जंघा पर हाथ रखो, प्रसन्न मन से पत्नी का आलिंगन करो। तुम दोनों यहाँ आनन्दित होते हुए सन्तान उत्पन्न करो; सविता तुम दोनों की आयु दीर्घ करे।
english: Mount; place the hand upon the thigh; embrace the wife with a kindly mind. You two, rejoicing here, make offspring; may Savitar make your life long.
notes: The addressee of the first line is not named in the unit; 'ūrum upa dhatsva hastam' is taken literally ('place the hand upon the thigh').
lines_deva: आ रो॑हो॒रुमुप॑ धत्स्व॒ हस्तं॒ परि॑ ष्वजस्व जा॒यां सु॑मन॒स्यमा॑नः
प्र॒जां कृ॑ण्वाथामि॒ह मोद॑मानौ दी॒र्घं वा॒मायुः॑ सवि॒ता कृ॑णोतु

pra̱jāṃ kṛ̭ṇvāthāmi̱ha moda̭mānau dī̱rghaṃ vā̱māyṷḥ savi̱tā kṛ̭ṇotu

hindi: प्रजापति तुम दोनों के लिए सन्तान उत्पन्न करे; अर्यमा दिन और रात के द्वारा तुम दोनों को भली-भाँति जोड़े। तुम अमंगल रहित होकर इस पतिलोक में प्रवेश करो; हमारे लिए, दो पैर वालों के लिए और चार पैर वालों के लिए कल्याणकारी बनो।
english: May Prajāpati bring forth offspring for you two; by day and night may Aryaman unite you. Not inauspicious, enter this world of the husband; be welfare for us, welfare for the two-footed, welfare for the four-footed.
notes: 'sam anaktu' (sam-√añj, lit. 'anoint together') is rendered 'unite'; the object 'you two' is understood from 'vām' in the same line. Whether 'ahorātrābhyām' means 'by day and night' or 'through day and night' is not settled by the text.
lines_deva: आ वां॑ प्र॒जां ज॑नयतु प्र॒जाप॑तिरहोरा॒त्राभ्यां॒ सम॑नक्त्वर्य॒मा
अदु॑र्मङ्गली पतिलो॒कमा वि॑शे॒मं शं नो॑ भव द्वि॒पदे॒ शं चतु॑ष्पदे
lines_iast: ā vā̭ṃ pra̱jāṃ ja̭nayatu pra̱jāpa̭tirahorā̱trābhyā̱ṃ sama̭naktvarya̱mā
adṷrmaṅgalī patilo̱kamā vi̭śe̱maṃ śaṃ no̭ bhava dvi̱pade̱ śaṃ catṷṣpade

hindi: देवों द्वारा मनु के साथ दिया हुआ यह वधू-सम्बन्धी वस्त्र और वधू का वस्त्र — जो जानने वाले ब्रह्मा को देता है, वही रक्षसों और शय्याओं को नष्ट करता है।
english: This bridal cloth and the bride's garment, given by the gods together with Manu: whoever gives it to the knowing brahman (priest) indeed slays the rakṣases and the couches.

'rakṣāṃsi talpāni' has no 'and' in the text; 'talpāni' may stand in apposition ('the rakṣases, the couches') and its exact sense is unclear. Gen. 'vadhvaḥ' (short a) is as printed; the usual gen. sg. of vadhū would be vadhvāḥ.

यो ब्र॒ह्मणे॑ चिकि॒तुषे॒ ददा॑ति॒ स इद् रक्षां॑सि॒ तल्पा॑नि हन्ति

yo bra̱hmaṇḙ ciki̱tuṣe̱ dadā̭ti̱ sa id rakṣā̭ṃsi̱ talpā̭ni hanti

hindi: जो ब्रह्मभाग तुम दोनों मुझे देते हो — वधू चाहने वाले का वधू-सम्बन्धी वस्त्र और वधू का वस्त्र — उसे ब्रह्मा के लिए अनुमति देते हुए तुम दोनों, हे बृहस्पति, इन्द्र के साथ दो।
english: The brahman's share which you two give me, the bridal cloth of the bride-seeker and the bride's garment: do you two, consenting for the brahman, O Bṛhaspati, together with Indra, give it.

text_flags.why: possible: the avagraha is unexpected here; read as vadhvaḥ (gen. sg.) + ca

notes: 'datto' is uncertain: dattaḥ is the regular 3 du. of √dā, and the regular 2 du. would be datthaḥ; it is rendered 'you two give' because the second line addresses the two (Bṛhaspati and Indra) with 'dattam'. 'me' may be 'to me' (the brahman speaking). The addressed pair is Bṛhaspati and Indra (vocative + nominative in line b). 'brahman' in brahmabhāgam and brahmaṇe is taken as the priest (Brahmā/brahman-priest); the neuter 'sacred utterance' is an alternative.
lines_deva: यं मे॑ द॒त्तो ब्र॑ह्मभा॒गं व॑धू॒योर्वाधू॑यं॒ वासो॑ व॒ध्वऽश्च॒ वस्त्र॑म्
यु॒वं ब्र॒ह्मणे॑ऽनुमन्य॑मानौ॒ बृह॑स्पते सा॒कमिन्द्र॑श्च द॒त्तम्

yu̱vaṃ bra̱hmaṇḙ'numanya̭mānau̱ bṛha̭spate sā̱kamindra̭śca da̱ttam

hindi: सुखद योनि से बँधे हुए, हँसी से आनन्दित, तेज से प्रमुदित होते हुए, सुगमता से चलने वाले, उत्तम पुत्रों वाले और उत्तम घर वाले तुम दोनों जीवित रहते हुए चमकती हुई उषाओं को पार करोगे।
english: Bound from the pleasant womb (seat), joyful in laughter, rejoicing with splendor, faring well, with good sons and a good home, you two, living, shall pass through the shining dawns.
notes: 'syonāt yoneḥ adhi' is rendered 'from the pleasant womb (or seat/origin)'; 'yoni' may mean womb, seat or home. 'hasāmudau' is read as hasā-mudau 'joyful with laughter'; other divisions are possible. 'sugū' ('faring well') is uncertain. 'tarātho' is taken as 2 du. subj. of √tṝ ('cross, pass through').
lines_deva: स्यो॒नाद्योने॒रधि॒ बध्य॑मानौ हसामु॒दौ मह॑सा॒ मोद॑मानौ
सु॒गू सु॑पु॒त्रौ सु॑गृ॒हौ त॑राथो जी॒वावु॒षसो॑ विभा॒तीः

hindi: नया वस्त्र पहने, सुगन्धित, सुन्दर वस्त्रों वाला, जीवित मैं चमकती हुई उषाओं की ओर उठ आया हूँ। जैसे अण्डे से पक्षी, वैसे मैं सब दोष से छूट गया हूँ।
english: Wearing a new garment, fragrant, well-clothed, living, I have come up to the shining dawns. Like a bird from the egg, I have been freed from every offence.
notes: 'navam' is taken as 'a new (garment)'; the noun is not stated. 'pari' is read with the ablative as 'away from'.
lines_deva: नवं॒ वसा॑नः सुर॒भिः सु॒वासा॑ उ॒दागां॑ जी॒व उ॒षसो॑ विभा॒तीः
आ॒ण्डात् प॑त॒त्रीवा॑मुक्षि॒ विश्व॑स्मा॒देन॑स॒स्परि॑
lines_iast: nava̱ṃ vasā̭naḥ sura̱bhiḥ su̱vāsā̭ u̱dāgā̭ṃ jī̱va u̱ṣaso̭ vibhā̱tīḥ
ā̱ṇḍāt pa̭ta̱trīvā̭mukṣi̱ viśva̭smā̱dena̭sa̱spari̭

hindi: सुशोभित करने वाले, समीप कृपा वाले, महान् व्रत वाले द्युलोक और पृथ्वी; सात दिव्य जल बह चुके हैं, वे हमें संकट से छुड़ाएँ।
english: Heaven and earth, adorning, whose favour is near, whose ordinance is great; the seven divine waters have flowed: may they release us from distress.
notes: 'aṃhas' (distress, narrowness) is rendered 'distress'; it is also used for 'sin'. 'mahivrate' may also be 'of great law'.
lines_deva: शुम्भ॑नी॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अन्ति॑सुम्ने॒ महि॑व्रते
आपः॑ स॒प्त सु॑स्रुवुर्दे॒वीस्ता नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः
lines_iast: śumbha̭nī̱ dyāvā̭pṛthi̱vī anti̭sumne̱ mahi̭vrate
āpa̭ḥ sa̱pta sṷsruvurde̱vīstā no̭ muñca̱ntvaṃha̭saḥ

hindi: सूर्या के लिए, देवों के लिए, मित्र और वरुण के लिए, और जो विद्यमान के विषय में सावधान हैं, उनके लिए मैंने यह नमस्कार किया है।
english: For Sūryā, for the gods, for Mitra and Varuṇa, and for those who are attentive to what exists: to them I have made this homage.
notes: 'bhūtasya pracetasaḥ' is literally 'those attentive of what exists'; 'bhūta' may also be 'being, creature'.
lines_deva: सू॒र्यायै॑ दे॒वेभ्यो॑ मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय च
ये भू॒तस्य॒ प्रचे॑तस॒स्तेभ्य॑ इ॒दम॑करं॒ नमः॑

hindi: जो बिना बन्धन के भी हँसली की हड्डियों के छेदन से पहले है; वह जोड़ को जोड़ने वाला, उदार, बहुत धन वाला और टूटे हुए को फिर से सुधारने वाला है।
english: He who, even without a binding, is there before the piercing at the collarbones: the joiner of the joint, the bounteous one, rich in goods, who sets right again what has been broken apart.
notes: The syntax of the first line is unclear: 'abhiśriṣaḥ', 'jatrubhyaḥ' and 'ātṛdaḥ' are each uncertain in case and sense, and the copula 'is there' is supplied. 'maghavan' is rendered 'bounteous one' (an epithet; no name is given in the unit). 'vihrutam' is read as 'bent or broken apart'.
lines_deva: य ऋ॒ते चि॑दभि॒श्रिषः॑ पु॒रा ज॒त्रुभ्य॑ आ॒तृदः॑
संधा॑ता सं॒धिं म॒घवा॑ पुरू॒वसु॒र्निष्क॑र्ता॒ विह्रु॑तं॒ पुनः॑
lines_iast: ya ṛ̱te ci̭dabhi̱śriṣa̭ḥ pu̱rā ja̱trubhya̭ ā̱tṛda̭ḥ

hindi: हमसे अन्धकार दूर हट जाए — जो नीला, पिंगल और लाल है। जो जलाने वाली पृषातकी इसमें है, उसे मैं स्थाणु पर बाँधता हूँ।
english: May the darkness shine away from us, whatever is dark-blue, tawny and also red. The consuming pṛṣātakī that is in this: that I fasten onto the post.
notes: 'pṛṣātakī' is left as a name (kind not stated in the line). 'asmin' ('in this') has no stated referent in the unit. 'sthāṇu' is rendered 'post' (also stump, stake). The digit 1 in the printed token is an accent notation.
lines_deva: अपा॒स्मत् तम॑ उच्छतु॒ नीलं॑ पि॒शङ्ग॑मु॒त लोहि॑तं॒ यत्
नि॒र्द॒ह॒नी या पृ॑षात॒क्य॑१स्मिन् तां स्था॒णावध्या स॑जामि

hindi: कृत्याएँ जितनी आवरण-वस्त्र में हैं, राजा वरुण के पाश जितने हैं, जो विफलताएँ और जो असमृद्धियाँ इसमें हैं — उन सबको मैं स्थाणु पर बैठाता हूँ।
english: As many spells (kṛtyā) as there are in the covering garment, as many as are the nooses of King Varuṇa, the failures and the non-successes that are in this: all those I set upon the post.
notes: 'kṛtyā' is rendered 'spell' (a harmful working); 'upavāsana' is rendered 'covering garment'. 'asmin' ('in this') has no stated referent in the unit. The printed token 'ṷpa̱vāsa̭ne̱' carries the printed accent mark ṷ on u.
lines_deva: याव॑तीः कृ॒त्या उ॑प॒वास॑ने॒ याव॑न्तो॒ राज्ञो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशाः॑
व्यृद्धयो॒ या अस॑मृद्धयो॒ या अ॒स्मिन् ता स्था॒णावधि॑ सादयामि

hindi: मेरा जो सबसे प्रिय शरीर है, वही मेरा शरीर वस्त्र से डर गया है। उसके आगे, हे वनस्पति, तुम नीवी बनाओ, जिससे हम हानि न उठाएँ।
english: The body of mine that is dearest, that of mine has feared the garment. In front of it, O lord of the forest, make a nīvi (garment-fold), that we may not be harmed.
notes: 'nīvi' is a part of a garment (fold or band); the exact sense is not given in the line. 'vāsasaḥ' is read as ablative 'of/from the garment' after 'bibhāya'; a genitive reading is possible. The speaker is not named.

english: Which ends, as many borders as there are, which weft-threads and which threads, the cloth that has been woven by wives: may that touch us pleasantly.
notes: 'sicaḥ' (borders) and 'otavaḥ' (weft-threads) are rendered literally; the exact textile senses are not stated. The first line is a list of items with no verb; it continues into the second line.
lines_deva: ये अन्ता॒ याव॑तीः॒ सिचो॒ य ओत॑वो॒ ये च॒ तन्त॑वः

english: If these long-haired people have danced together in your house, making evil with weeping, may Agni and Savitar release you from that offence.
notes: 'samanartiṣuḥ' is read as 3 pl. aorist of sam-√nṛt ('danced together'); the root is not certain. The digit 3 in the printed final token of line 1 is an accent notation. 'te' is taken as 'your' (genitive) with 'gṛhe'.

lines_iast: i̱yaṃ nāryupa̭ brūte̱ pūlyā̭nyāvapanti̱kā
dī̱rghāyṷrastu me̱ pati̱rjīvā̭ti śa̱rada̭ḥ śa̱tam

hindi: हे इन्द्र, इन दोनों दम्पति को यहाँ चक्रवाक पक्षियों के जोड़े की तरह मिला दो। ये दोनों सन्तान के साथ कल्याणयुक्त होकर पूरी आयु प्राप्त करें।
english: Here, O Indra, bring these two together, the married couple, like cakravāka birds. With offspring, fortunate, may these two attain a full lifetime.
notes: 'sam nuda' (sam-√nud) is rendered 'bring together'. 'cakravāka' is a kind of bird. 'dampatī' (lit. 'lords of the house') is taken as the couple, in apposition to 'imau'. The case of 'enau' with the middle verb is irregular for a nominative dual; read as 'these two'. 'svastakau' is rendered 'fortunate'.
lines_deva: इ॒हेमावि॑न्द्र॒ सं नु॑द चक्रवा॒केव॒ दंप॑ती
प्र॒जयै॑नौ स्वस्त॒कौ विश्व॒मायु॒र्व्यऽश्नुताम्
lines_iast: i̱hemāvi̭ndra̱ saṃ nṷda cakravā̱keva̱ daṃpa̭tī
pra̱jayai̭nau svasta̱kau viśva̱māyu̱rvya'śnutām

hindi: आसन्दी पर, तकिये पर, या आवरण-वस्त्र में जो कुछ किया गया हो, और विवाह में तथा स्नान में जिस कृत्या को उन्होंने रचा, उसे हम नीचे रख देते हैं।
english: Whatever was done on the seat, on the cushion, or in the covering garment, and the spell (kṛtyā) which they made at the wedding, at the bathing: that we lay down.
notes: Only 'tām' (the kṛtyā) is the grammatical object of 'ni dadhmasi'; the first relative clause ('yat ... kṛtam') has no verb of its own. 'āsandī' is rendered 'seat', 'upadhāna' 'cushion'.
lines_deva: यदा॑स॒न्द्यामु॑प॒धाने॒ यद् वो॑प॒वास॑ने कृ॒तम्
वि॒वा॒हे कृ॒त्यां यां च॒क्रुरा॒स्नाने॒ तां नि द॑ध्मसि
lines_iast: yadā̭sa̱ndyāmṷpa̱dhāne̱ yad vo̭pa̱vāsa̭ne kṛ̱tam
vi̱vā̱he kṛ̱tyāṃ yāṃ ca̱krurā̱snāne̱ tāṃ ni da̭dhmasi

hindi: जो दुष्कृत, जो मल विवाह में और वधू-यात्रा में है — उस दुरित को हम संभल के कम्बल में पोंछ देते हैं।
english: Whatever misdeed, whatever stain there is at the wedding and at the bridal procession: that evil we wipe off in the blanket of the saṃbhala.
notes: 'saṃbhala' is left untranslated (kind of thing not stated); 'vahatu' is rendered 'bridal procession' (as in unit 73).
lines_deva: यद् दु॑ष्कृ॒तं यच्छम॑लं विवा॒हे व॑ह॒तौ च॒ यत्
तत् सं॑भ॒लस्य॑ कम्ब॒ले मृ॒ज्महे॑ दुरि॒तं व॒यम्
lines_iast: yad dṷṣkṛ̱taṃ yacchama̭laṃ vivā̱he va̭ha̱tau ca̱ yat
tat sa̭ṃbha̱lasya̭ kamba̱le mṛ̱jmahḙ duri̱taṃ va̱yam

hindi: संभल में मल को रखकर और कम्बल में दुरित को रखकर हम यज्ञ के योग्य और शुद्ध हो गए हैं; हमारी आयु आगे बढ़े।
english: Having set the stain in the saṃbhala, and the evil in the blanket, we have become fit for sacrifice, pure; may our lives be lengthened.
notes: The line has no verb for the blanket clause; 'having set down' is carried over. The subject of 'tāriṣat' is not named; rendered impersonally ('may our lives be lengthened').
lines_deva: सं॒भ॒ले मलं॑ सादयित्वा क॑म्बले दु॑रितं व॒यम्
अभू॑म य॒ज्ञियाः॑ शु॒द्धाः प्र ण॒ आयूं॑षि तारिषत्
lines_iast: sa̱ṃbha̱le mala̭ṃ sādayitvā ka̭mbale dṷritaṃ va̱yam
abhṷ̄ma ya̱jñiyā̭ḥ śu̱ddhāḥ pra ṇa̱ āyṷ̄ṃṣi tāriṣat

hindi: यह जो सौ दाँतों वाला बनावटी काँटा है, वह इसके केश के मल को और सिर के मल को खुरचकर दूर करे।
english: This made thorn with a hundred teeth: may it scrape away from her the impurity of the hair, that of the head.
notes: 'kaṇṭaka' is kept as 'thorn'; the text only says it has a hundred teeth and is made. 'śīrṣaṇyam' is taken with 'malam' (understood).
lines_deva: कृ॒त्रिमः॒ कण्ट॑कः श॒तद॒न् य ए॒षः
अपा॒स्याः केश्यं॒ मल॒मप॑ शीर्ष॒ण्यं लिखात्
lines_iast: kṛ̱trima̱ḥ kaṇṭa̭kaḥ śa̱tada̱n ya e̱ṣaḥ
apā̱syāḥ keśya̱ṃ mala̱mapa̭ śīrṣa̱ṇyaṃ likhāt

hindi: इसके अंग-अंग से हम यक्ष्म को दूर रखते हैं। वह पृथ्वी तक न पहुँचे, न देवों तक, न द्युलोक तक, न विस्तृत अन्तरिक्ष तक पहुँचे। यह मल जलों तक न पहुँचे, हे अग्नि; वह यम तक और सब पितरों तक न पहुँचे।
english: From each limb of her we lay away the wasting disease (yakṣma). May it not reach the earth, nor the gods, nor heaven; may it not reach the wide atmosphere. May this stain not reach the waters, O Agni; may it not reach Yama, nor all the fathers.
notes: 'tat' in line b is the yakṣma of line a. The unit has three printed lines (a, b, c) as one numbered verse; the grouping is kept as given.
lines_deva: अङ्गा॑द॒ङ्गाद् व॒यम॒स्या अप॒ यक्ष्मं॒ नि द॑ध्मसि
तन्मा प्राप॑त् पृथि॒वीं मोत दे॒वान् दिवं॒ मा प्राप॑दु॒र्व॑१न्तरि॑क्षम्
अ॒पो मा प्राप॒न्मल॑मे॒तद॑ग्ने य॒मं मा प्राप॑त् पि॒तॄंश्च॒ सर्वा॑न्
lines_iast: aṅgā̭da̱ṅgād va̱yama̱syā apa̱ yakṣma̱ṃ ni da̭dhmasi
tanmā prāpa̭t pṛthi̱vīṃ mota de̱vān diva̱ṃ mā prāpa̭du̱rva̭1ntari̭kṣam
a̱po mā prāpa̱nmala̭me̱tada̭gne ya̱maṃ mā prāpa̭t pi̱tṝṃśca̱ sarvā̭n

hindi: मैं तुम्हें पृथ्वी के दूध से बाँधता हूँ, मैं तुम्हें ओषधियों के दूध से बाँधता हूँ; मैं तुम्हें सन्तान और धन से बाँधता हूँ। वह तुम, भली-भाँति बँधी हुई, इस बल को प्राप्त करो।
english: I bind you together with the milk of the earth; I bind you together with the milk of the plants; I bind you together with offspring and wealth. Bound together, win this vigor.
notes: 'payas' (milk, juice) is rendered 'milk'. 'vāja' is rendered 'vigor' (it can also mean prize or food). 'sā' is addressed to the 'you' (feminine) already bound.
lines_deva: सं त्वा॑ नह्यामि॒ पय॑सा पृथि॒व्याः सं त्वा॑ नह्यामि॒ पय॒सौष॑धीनाम्
सं त्वा॑ नह्यामि प्र॒जया॒ धने॑न॒ सा संन॑द्धा सनुहि॒ वाज॒मेमम्
lines_iast: saṃ tvā̭ nahyāmi̱ paya̭sā pṛthi̱vyāḥ saṃ tvā̭ nahyāmi̱ paya̱sauṣa̭dhīnām
saṃ tvā̭ nahyāmi pra̱jayā̱ dhanḙna̱ sā saṃna̭ddhā sanuhi̱ vāja̱memam

hindi: मैं अम हूँ, तुम सा हो; मैं साम हूँ, तुम ऋक् हो; मैं द्यौ हूँ, तुम पृथ्वी हो। वे ही हम दोनों यहाँ मिलें और सन्तान उत्पन्न करें।
english: I am Ama, you are Sā; I am Sāman, you are Ṛc; I am heaven, you are earth. As such two, let us come together here and beget offspring.
notes: 'ama' and 'sā' are the pair 'he' and 'she' (pronoun-words used as names); 'sāman' is a chant and 'ṛc' a verse. 'amo'ham' keeps the avagraha as printed.
lines_deva: अमो॒ऽहम॑स्मि॒ सा त्वं सामा॒हम॒स्म्यृक् त्वं द्यौर॒हं पृ॑थि॒वी त्वम्
तावि॒ह सं भ॑वाव प्र॒जामा ज॑नयावहै
lines_iast: amo̱'hama̭smi̱ sā tvaṃ sāmā̱hama̱smyṛk tvaṃ dyaura̱haṃ pṛ̭thi̱vī tvam
tāvi̱ha saṃ bha̭vāva pra̱jāmā ja̭nayāvahai

words.gloss: may we two follow, be joined

hindi: अविवाहित पुरुष पत्नी की कामना करते हैं, उदार लोग पुत्रों की कामना करते हैं। हम दोनों अक्षत प्राण वाले होकर महान् बल की प्राप्ति के लिए साथ रहें।
english: The unwed desire wives, the generous desire sons. May we two, with unharmed vitality, be joined for the great winning of vigor.

text_flags.why: possible: the sense 'the unwed desire wives' and the parallel janiyanti / putriyanti suggest nu agravaḥ; the printed nāvagravaḥ is kept

notes: 'agru' ('unwed') is uncertain in sense. If the printed form 'nāvagravaḥ' is correct, the division is unclear. 'vāja' is rendered 'vigor' (prize, food are also possible).
lines_deva: ज॒नि॒यन्ति॑ ना॒वग्र॑वः पुत्रि॒यन्ति॑ सु॒दान॑वः
अरि॑ष्टासू सचेवहि बृह॒ते वाज॑सातये
lines_iast: ja̱ni̱yanti̭ nā̱vagra̭vaḥ putri̱yanti̭ su̱dāna̭vaḥ
ari̭ṣṭāsū sacevahi bṛha̱te vāja̭sātaye

hindi: जो पितर, वधू को देखने वाले, इस वधू-यात्रा में आए हैं, वे इस वधू को, इस सम्पत्नी को सन्तानयुक्त आश्रय प्रदान करें।
english: The fathers, the bride-seers, who have come to this bridal procession: may they grant to this bride, the joint wife, shelter with offspring.
notes: 'saṃpatnī' ('joint wife', one who shares the household with her husband) is uncertain in sense. 'vahatu' is rendered 'bridal procession'. 'śarman' is rendered 'shelter'.
lines_deva: ये पि॒तरो॑ वधूद॒र्शा इमं व॑ह॒तुमाग॑मन्
ते अ॒स्यै व॒ध्वै संप॑त्न्यै प्र॒जाव॒च्छर्म॑ यच्छन्तु
lines_iast: ye pi̱taro̭ vadhūda̱rśā imaṃ va̭ha̱tumāga̭man
te a̱syai va̱dhvai saṃpa̭tnyai pra̱jāva̱ccharma̭ yacchantu

words.gram: pres. part. f. nom. sg. denom.

hindi: जो यह पहले यहाँ आई, रशना की भाँति आचरण करती हुई, इसके लिए सन्तान और धन यहाँ देकर — उसे वे न गए हुए के मार्ग पर ले चलें; उत्तम सन्तान वाली यह विराट् जीत चुकी है।
english: She who came here first, acting as a girdle, having given offspring and wealth here to this one: may they convey her along the path of the not-gone; this sovereign, with good offspring, has overcome.

text_flags.why: possible: agatasya (a-gata, 'not gone') is unclear; āgatasya ('of the one who has come') is an alternative, but the printed form is kept

notes: Low confidence. 'raśanāyamānā' (denominative of raśanā, 'girdle') is rendered 'acting as a girdle'. 'agatasya' is uncertain (a-gata 'not gone', ā-gata 'come', or a name). 'atyajaiṣīt' has no stated object ('has overcome'). The referents of 'who came first', 'this one' and 'this sovereign' are not named in the unit.
lines_deva: येदं पूर्वाग॑न् रशना॒यमा॑ना प्र॒जाम॒स्यै द्रवि॑णं चे॒ह द॒त्त्वा
तां व॑ह॒न्त्वग॑त॒स्यानु॒ पन्थां॑ वि॒राडि॒यं सु॑प्र॒जा अत्य॑जैषीत्
lines_iast: yedaṃ pūrvāga̭n raśanā̱yamā̭nā pra̱jāma̱syai dravi̭ṇaṃ ce̱ha da̱ttvā
tāṃ va̭ha̱ntvaga̭ta̱syānu̱ panthā̭ṃ vi̱rāḍi̱yaṃ sṷpra̱jā atya̭jaiṣīt

words.gram: pres. mid. part. f. nom. sg. √budh

hindi: जाग उठो; भली-भाँति जागती हुई, दीर्घ आयु के लिए, सौ शरद् ऋतुओं के लिए। घरों को जाओ, ताकि तुम गृहपत्नी बनो; सविता तुम्हारी आयु दीर्घ करे।
english: Awake; awakening with good wakefulness, for long life, for a hundred autumns. Go to the houses, that you may be mistress of the house; may Savitar make your life long.
notes: 'subudhā' is taken as an instrumental ('with good wakefulness'); a nominative-feminine adjective reading ('well awake') is also possible. 'autumns' stands for years.
lines_deva: प्र बु॑ध्यस्व सु॒बुधा॒ बुध्य॑माना दीर्घायु॒त्वाय॑ श॒तशा॑रदाय
गृ॒हान् ग॑च्छ गृ॒हप॑त्नी॒ यथासो॑ दी॒र्घं त॒ आयुः॑ सवि॒ता कृ॑णोतु
lines_iast: pra bṷdhyasva su̱budhā̱ budhya̭mānā dīrghāyu̱tvāya̭ śa̱taśā̭radāya
gṛ̱hān ga̭ccha gṛ̱hapa̭tnī̱ yathāso̭ dī̱rghaṃ ta̱ āyṷḥ savi̱tā kṛ̭ṇotu
